name: Seikan Esute ~Midara na Yubitsukai ni Midareru Onna-tachi~
original_name: 性感エステ ～淫らな指使いに乱れる女たち～
source:
"Thank you for your patronage. Please come again, you're always welcome......"

In spite of booming business at my salon, I was unfulfilled.
Touching the bare skin of beautiful women but forbidden from making love was agony.
No matter the opportunity, I couldn't make a move.

Days passed with slow, tortured self-restraint, my platonic hands on their inviting curves.

Then, a web banner for a "mood" aromatherapy caught my eye.

Reviews for the aroma read like erotic novels and pornographic letters to the editor.
Customers assured that the aromatherapy was 100% effective.
Women became horny. As I read the reviews, my heart began to race.

I had every reason to try this "aroma-phrodisiac" at my salon.

"No matter the woman, her mood will open like the pedals of a flower... I can have fun..."

translation:
“感谢您的光临，欢迎下次再来……”

尽管我的美容院生意兴隆，我却始终感到空虚。
抚摸美女裸露的肌肤，却被禁止与她们做爱，简直令人痛苦。机会再好，我也不敢采取行动。

日子在缓慢而煎熬的自我克制中流逝，我那只柏拉图式的手，始终停留在她们诱人的曲线上。

这时，我注意到一个“情绪”芳香疗法的网页广告。

介绍香气的评论读起来像色情小说和情色读者来信。顾客保证，芳香疗法百分之百有效。女人会变得淫荡。我读着评论，心跳逐渐加快。

我有充分理由在美容院试试这种“香气催情剂”。

“无论什么样的女人，她的情绪都会像花瓣一样绽放……我可以尽情享受……”
